name: omnipack/forge
description: Software forge for omnisense/omnibase: software and its versions, builds per platform, downloads, each version's documentation and a publish API. Licences and paid downloads (omnipack/marketplace), releases from git tags and a Composer repository (git/git-bundle) and a Unity registry (omnisense/omnihub) switch on when their packages are installed

suggest.omnipack/marketplace: ^2.0: licences sold, paid downloads, one-click purchases, support hours, quotes, invoices and client projects (Base\Forge\Feature::MARKETPLACE); without it every software is free and no checkout route exists
suggest.omnisense/omnitrade: ^1.2 with a provider that saves payment methods: one-click purchases from Forge Store and Forge Hub (forge.hub.payment_gateway, docs/hub.md)
suggest.omnitrade/stripe: ^1.2: Stripe as forge.hub.payment_gateway (a saved card read back when its buyer returns)
suggest.omnitrade/paypal: ^1.2: PayPal as forge.hub.payment_gateway (an approved setup turned into a saved method when its buyer returns)
suggest.git/git-bundle: ^1.0: releases built from the repositories' tags, their archives, the Composer index, the repositories' docs/ and history (Base\Forge\Feature::GIT); without it the builds are attached
suggest.ext-git2: Required by git/git-bundle to read repositories (releases, the project dashboard's history)
suggest.omnisense/omnihub: ^1.0, with git/git-bundle: the Unity registry (/upm) and the hub clients' manifest and catalogue (Base\Forge\Feature::HUB)
suggest.omnisense/omnistate: ^1.0 with a register provider (omnistate/annuaire-entreprises): the quote form's SIRET check, through omnipack/marketplace's company register
suggest.omnidocs/markdown: ^1.0: each version's documentation read with omnidocs (callouts, code frames, headings); league/commonmark alone renders it plainly, and without either it shows as Markdown
suggest.league/commonmark: ^2.6: each version's documentation rendered as HTML when omnidocs/markdown is not installed
suggest.symfony/http-client: Reads the pipelines' runs from GitHub Actions (Pipeline\GithubActionsSource)
suggest.symfony/yaml: The stages of a GitHub Actions run, from its workflow file's needs
